result.summary: Правило «отбросить закрывающие скобки в конце значения» теперь записано как один проход: счётчики открывающих и закрывающих знаков и один ход назад, без поиска пары для каждой скобки. Запуск показал, что прежнее чтение квадратично (17 секунд на 1 МиБ), а новое линейно (15 миллисекунд); добавлены двенадцатое семейство прибора и мутант, который его краснит. Для выживших мутантов добавлены пары образцов (точка после JWT, заглушка из двух знаков, левая граница у ключей и Bearer, точка с запятой), остальные названы принятыми с направлением ошибки; контроль прибора оставлен с тремя повторами, как в требовании (97 секунд из 120), а кавычки в новых текстах поправки теперь записаны с экранированием.

issues.text: V4 choice for ORCH and REQ-VALIDATOR: the control keeps three repeats on 128 KiB (the requirement's number). Measured with twelve families the whole instrument takes 97.4 s of 120 s (margin 1.23, smaller than the 1.8 of the earlier versions); the single measurement would take 75.6 s. The amendment G-6 is withdrawn, so the requirement's control sentence stays as it is and the fallback sentence is unused. If ORCH prefers the larger margin, the single measurement and G-6 come back as in 03e (one item); no default is waiting.

V2 and V3 added one amendment item beyond A-K: item L (the left boundary 'слева не буква и не цифра' in Ф5 and Ф6 of the requirement; one new Old text, occurs once). It is a clarification of M5 and M6, which the old code already has; relative to the old rules it narrows nothing. The pairs for the other survivors go into the New texts of K-1, K-2, K-3 only. The oracle grows to 106 kept and 108 refused entries.

V1 reading chosen: a trailing closer is dropped when the value holds more closers of its kind than openers (the pairing reading of the requirement's «нет парной открывающей»). The oracle gives the same result under the presence reading (a closer is dropped when the value has no opener of its kind) and under the naive reading, so no sample separates them; the text of item 3 fixes the counting reading. It is worth one line in the record 0103.

For TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR: the mutant m43 is killed by family 12 only after about 167 s on the slower machine (ten calls of 17 s at 1 MiB, the run stops at the first ratio 15.86 and never reaches 4 MiB). Not a defect, a planning figure.

Fact of the task checked: the validator's figures for the naive reading (0.54 s at 256 KiB ... 137.9 s at 4 MiB) are for its machine; on this one the same reading costs 1.09 s, 4.3 s and 17.1 s at 256 KiB, 512 KiB and 1 MiB (same quadratic growth). The line numbers of the block in docs/requirements.yaml moved by one because another run edited the file above the block; the block itself is byte-identical. No open question for ORCH.
